productionDate.note: The catalogue gives only the era label. The year the rubbing was taken is not recorded, so no year is stored.

dimensions.note: Axis order is not stated in the catalogue entry.

currentCollection.note: Published in the Palace Museum's online collection catalogue under museum object number 新00045406. The entry does not state a storage room, gallery, or exhibition status, and it gives no date for the holding.
currentCollection.noteZh: 著录于故宫博物院线上藏品目录，馆藏编号新00045406。条目没有说明库房、展厅或展出状态，也没有给出入藏时间。

review.note: Draft record. The collection assertion comes from the publishing museum's own catalogue entry but has not been independently reviewed.
review.noteZh: 草稿记录。现藏依据出自收藏机构自己的目录条目，但尚未经过独立审核。

notes: No custody events are recorded for this rubbing yet. The original stone's documented 1922–1948 movements are not copied into this record.

The catalogue quotes an entry in 《欧斋藏碑帖目录》 that lists the item with mounting details and purchase prices. That entry has not been analysed as provenance evidence and is not used here to assert a chain of custody.
The catalogue does not state that this rubbing was taken from the stone recovered in 1922, so no rubbing-of relation is asserted between the two objects.
Neither the rubbing year nor any intermediate owner is documented in the sources audited for this task.
notesZh: 这件拓本目前没有保管事件的记载。原石 1922 至 1948 年有据可查的移动，没有抄录到本条记录。
条目引用了《欧斋藏碑帖目录》中的一则著录，列有装裱信息与购藏价格。该著录尚未作为流传证据分析，这里不用它来主张保管链条。
条目没有说明此拓取自 1922 年出土的那块原石，因此两件实物之间不主张「拓自」关系。
本次核查的来源中，既没有拓制年份，也没有中间收藏者的记载。
